name: Translator
short_desc: Translate Thai, English and more privately, or offline on your phone
author: Humanity Labs
description: Private translation between Thai, English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Spanish, French, German and Russian. Best quality comes from a private AI model through your Tinfoil app (connect Tinfoil first); the Firefox Translations engine also runs offline on your phone. The box keeps no model of its own: about 160 MB of RAM.
